title: After Dark: No Filter Edition
description: An unfiltered adult game night covering bedroom vocabulary, Star Wars deep cuts, gloriously gross biology, 2010s pop nostalgia, internet memes, and situations too funny to forget.

questions.question: Associated with 19th-century religious missionaries who reportedly promoted it as the only 'proper' configuration, this is the most conventional face-to-face bedroom position.
Channeling rodeo energy, this top position has one partner astride the other while facing their partner's face.
The numerical name of this mutually reciprocal act describes the inverted shape the two participants' bodies form together.
Named after humanity's most beloved domesticated animal, this rear-entry position has the receiving partner on all fours.
Rooted in tantric tradition, this face-to-face seated position — named after the flower symbolizing spiritual enlightenment — has the receiver wrapping their legs around their partner's waist.
This moon-sized Imperial superweapon, armed with a planet-destroying superlaser, was obliterated by the Rebel Alliance in the climax of the original 1977 Star Wars film.
This towering Wookiee co-pilot of the Millennium Falcon fought alongside the Rebels at Yavin 4 but notably did not receive a medal at the victory ceremony.
This blue-and-white astromech droid carried the stolen Death Star plans inside its memory banks at the very opening of the original trilogy.
This Jedi Master trained Anakin Skywalker as his Padawan before ultimately sacrificing his own life aboard the Death Star to let his friends escape.
This Mandalorian bounty hunter has roughly six minutes of screen time in the original trilogy yet became one of the franchise's most iconic and beloved characters.
The ear canal secretes this yellowish waxy substance to trap dust and bacteria, which most people attempt to remove with cotton swabs despite widespread medical advice against it.
This thick, yellow-white fluid visible at the site of an infected wound consists primarily of dead white blood cells that have engulfed invading bacteria.
The formal medical term for chronic bad breath, derived from the Latin word for 'breath,' affects an estimated 25% of the global population.
Trichophyton rubrum, a fungal infection that thrives in the warm, damp spaces between toes, carries this two-word common name associated with sports despite affecting plenty of non-athletes.
Central American fly Dermatobia hominis hitches its eggs onto mosquitoes, which deliver them under human skin — causing larvae to grow beneath the surface in this parasitic condition.
questions.answer: What is a bot fly infestation?

questions.question: The 2013 Disney hit Frozen featured 'Let It Go,' performed by this Tony Award-winning actress who previously played Elphaba in Wicked on Broadway.
Discovered on YouTube as a teenager by manager Scooter Braun, this Canadian singer's 2010 debut single 'Baby' made him briefly the world's most Googled person.
Miley Cyrus's 2013 MTV VMA performance with Robin Thicke introduced this provocative low-squat hip-gyrating dance move to mainstream vocabulary.
Dropping at midnight in December 2013 with zero advance notice, this self-titled visual album sold 828,000 copies on iTunes in three days and redefined how artists release music.
Launched in 2013 and shut down by Twitter in 2017, this short-form platform pioneered the six-second looping video format that inspired a generation of creators.
In 2007, clicking an apparently legitimate hyperlink that secretly redirected to Rick Astley's 1987 hit 'Never Gonna Give You Up' became known as this internet prank.
A 2012 Reddit post featuring a perpetually scowling cat named Tardar Sauce spawned millions of captioned images and made this feline the internet's most famous sourpuss.
This 2013 meme features a bespectacled Shiba Inu surrounded by Comic Sans text fragments like 'wow,' 'such amaze,' and 'very coin' expressing the dog's inner monologue.
A 2015 Tumblr image of a striped dress divided the internet over whether it appeared blue and black or white and gold, prompting scientific debate about this visual phenomenon.

Cartoonist Matt Furie created this laid-back green amphibian in 2005 for a webcomic called 'Boy's Club' — the character later became one of the internet's most repurposed and controversial meme figures.
At the 2017 Academy Awards, presenters read the wrong envelope and announced 'La La Land' as Best Picture before realizing this film had actually won.
A 2009 Colorado hoax convinced TV networks a boy named Falcon was floating in a runaway weather balloon — the scheme collapsed when Falcon revealed the truth live on CNN.
questions.answer: What is the Balloon Boy hoax?

questions.question: Ticket-holders paid thousands for a 'luxury' Bahamas music festival experience in 2017 and arrived to find disaster-relief tents, pre-packaged cheese sandwiches, and zero performers.
At the 2004 Iowa caucuses, this presidential candidate's victory speech ended with a piercing spontaneous scream that went viral and effectively ended his campaign.
In 1986, Geraldo Rivera's live TV special about this mobster's sealed Chicago vault drew 30 million viewers — and revealed only rubble and empty bottles inside.
